facts.fact: Limits that protect the chain agents' budget
facts.value: per IP: 5 fresh reads a minute, 40 an hour, 100 a day; 3 reads at once; one read per address however many people ask; 15-minute cache; Lens's own daily share: Solana 1,200 RPC calls, 2,250 per EVM chain, 2,000 Sourcify and 2,000 OtterSec lookups, at most a quarter of each in one hour; at most 50 new SEPIA-1 items a day from Lens

each read is judged by the same function the chain agents use; a new verified program or contract the rules keep is added to the SEPIA-1 chain index with discovery source 'lens'; memecoins, token mints and template contracts stay rejected

avoid: crawler, crawl, crawling (say: reads, agents, chain agents)
audit / audited / security audit / 'safe' / 'rug check' / 'scam detector': Lens reports what the code and chain say; it does not certify anything
AI-generated report, LLM, 'our AI analyses': no model writes any part of a report
INK points, earn $INK: contributors earn credits
'first ever', 'nothing like it exists', claims about $CRAWL / $CLAUS: not verified
'byte-identical to the original repo' / 'the source of this file is X': the code index holds one copy of a shared file; say 'the same file is in <repo>@<commit>'
'full Solidity parser' or 'finds every admin function': privileged detection is pattern-based
presenting local QA numbers (reads served, calls left today) as lusca.ink usage
